root_cause: The unchanged upstream CategoriesTest asks KLocalizedString for installed libdiscover domain translations. The clean Debian test phase runs before dh_auto_install, while upstream ki18n_install(po) materializes the translation catalogs through the install step. The test therefore saw only the source language even though the signed upstream source contains the translation PO tree.
repair_scope: Packaging/test environment only. Revision2 stages the unchanged CMake install tree into a temporary DESTDIR before CategoriesTest and points XDG_DATA_DIRS at that staged usr/share. Upstream source, test assertions, Qt and Frameworks remain unchanged.
reentry: Increment Debian revision to 6.7.5-0supralinux2, invalidate preflight48 for the new packaging bytes, run cheap regression checks and obtain a fresh authoritative input preflight before Attempt2.
